subject: Science and Fine Arts Curriculum Review
overview: The Curriculum Subcommittee met remotely to receive presentations on the district's K–12 science and fine arts curricula. Department leaders outlined framework alignments, course offerings, textbook and resource needs, and instructional adjustments made during the pandemic.

items.title: Meeting Opening and Agenda Review
items.summary: Paulette Van der Kloot opened the meeting and outlined the agenda focused on reviewing science and fine arts curricula across all grade levels.

items.title: Science Curriculum Review
items.summary: Science Director Rocco Cieri presented an overview of K–12 science instruction, state framework alignment, high school course sequences, and textbook needs for biology and chemistry.

items.title: Fine Arts Curriculum Review
items.summary: Dr. Bernadette Ricciardelli presented on the fine arts curriculum, reviewing state framework revisions, online tools like Quaver Music, instrument access, and upcoming budgetary needs.
